subject: CascadeAI — privacy follow-up: DPA preference & SCC module guidance
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Li <evan.li@cascade.ai>, Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@cascade.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo: quick privacy/security follow-up (DPA / SCC / SOC 2)

Thanks again for taking the call today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned while your legal/security team evaluates Redwood.

Call highlights:
- SOC 2: Redwood is currently completing Type II testing for the period ending 2026-09-30; we can provide a SOC 2 status memo and our interim control summary now, and the full Type II report when available.
- GDPR: For typical customer relationships (Cascade as controller, Redwood as processor) the applicable SCC path is Module 2 (controller -> processor). We prefer Module 2 in the DPA but can discuss if you need another module for any specific data flows.
- HIPAA: Redwood offers HIPAA controls and a BA agreement as an addendum; we can surface the BAA template if you have HIPAA-covered workloads.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Which SCC module do you prefer as a starting point? (Module 2 is our default for controller->processor).
2) Can you share the security questionnaire you mentioned on the call so our InfoSec can target answers?
3) Any must-have DPA clauses (retention, subprocessors, audit rights) to flag upfront?

Attachments I will send in a follow-up: Redwood standard DPA (v1.2) and a short SOC 2 readiness memo. Im attaching a blank vendor security questionnaire template for you to fill (so we can pre-populate answers where straightforward).

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- EOD Fri (6/12): you share your completed questionnaire and any DPA redline priorities.
- Week of 6/15: legal-to-legal touchpoint if needed; Redwood legal triages redlines.
- Target: Have DPA milestone (initial redline) by 6/22 to keep procurement on track for a July production window.

If that works, Ill loop Legal (Priya) to pick up the DPA thread and Tessa (Solutions) for any technical follow-ups on data residency and retention.

Thanks —
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
<aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Redwood Inference | www.redwood.ai

Attachments (sent in follow-up): redwood_standard_dpa_v1.2.pdf, SOC2-prelim-assertion.pdf, redwood_vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx

From: Evan Li <evan.li@cascade.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@cascade.ai>, legal@cascade.ai, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: quick privacy/security follow-up (DPA / SCC / SOC 2)

Thanks Aisha — quick answers and a file attached.

1) SCC module: Cascades legal prefers Module 2 (controller -> processor) for vendor relationships. That matches what you suggested.
2) Questionnaire: attached is our security questionnaire (we filled what we could; still have legal questions). File: vendor_security_q_filled_by_cascade.xlsx (attached).
3) Key DPA asks up front: 90-day data retention option for logs, standard audit rights (on-site/remote), and a subprocessors list before go-live. If Redwood has a preferred subprocessors list doc we can review, that would help.

One additional asks: can you confirm if Redwoods standard DPA accepts EU SCC Module 2 without additional controller-controller mapping? Also, SOC 2 Type II report timing is important — my legal team will want the final report or a formal remediation statement if controls are still in testing.

Evan
Evan Li
Head of Security & Compliance, Cascade AI
evan.li@cascade.ai
+1 (415) 555-0122

Attachment: vendor_security_q_filled_by_cascade.xlsx

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo: quick privacy/security follow-up (DPA / SCC / SOC 2)

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the completed questionnaire — thats super helpful. A few clarifications and next steps below.

Answers / clarifications:
- SCC module: confirm Redwood accepts Module 2 (controller -> processor) as the standard choice for customer relationships. We will provide Module 2 language in the DPA and can call out any additional mapping if Cascade requires it.
- Subprocessors: we maintain a public subprocessors page and will share the link; for onboarding we can provide the current list and commit to notification windows for changes.
- SOC 2: Im attaching a short SOC 2 readiness memo (SOC2-prelim-assertion.pdf) that summarizes our current testing window and expected delivery of Type II. Legal often accepts the memo plus an audit clause tying final acceptance to delivery of the final report; Priya can advise on standard contract language.

Attachments (attached to this email):
- redwood_standard_dpa_v1.2.pdf (DPA with Module 2 as the default SCC path)
- SOC2-prelim-assertion.pdf (high level status memo)
- redwood_vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx (our version to help crosswalk answers)

Proposed mutual action plan:
- Today (6/12): Cascade confirms any DPA clauses that are non-negotiable (retention, audit window, subprocessors).
- 6/15: Redwood legal (Priya) to do a first-pass redline on the DPA and call out any SCC-specific edits.
- 6/18: 30-min legal-to-legal call to close outstanding items if there are any.

Ill ask Priya to pick up the DPA review and Tessa to review the questionnaire with your answers. If Cascade wants a formal BAA for HIPAA, we can surface that as a follow-up addendum.

Thanks —
Aisha

Attachments: redwood_standard_dpa_v1.2.pdf, SOC2-prelim-assertion.pdf, redwood_vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx
